title: Vanishing above the extension level
statement: Let $J$ be an essentially small site, $O$ a commutative ring, $\ell\in O$, $B_n=(O/(\ell^{n+1}))_J$, and $\mathsf S_B$ the category of strict successive semilinear systems of $B_n$-module sheaves [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension]. Fix an ordinary extension $E_n\dashv e_n$ with its stated zero components above $n$, and its universal derived extension $LE_n$ with derived evaluation $e_q$ and K-flat comparison [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-derived-core]. For arbitrary independently chosen unbounded derived categories, for every $n<q$ and $N\in D(B_n)$, the object $e_qLE_nN$ is zero. No flatness of quotient coefficient maps or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21: the functors e_n! and (Le_n!, e_n^-1), with indices shifted from n >= 0 to n >= 1. The natural sigma maps are the truncation inclusions in its explicit formula; the Hom identity specifies their adjunction mates.

proof.text: Represent the derived input by a complex and take a K-flat resolution. The core counit is invertible on that resolution.

Every term of its extension evaluated above n is zero by the ordinary above-level formula, hence the evaluated complex is zero. Localization preserves zero objects, and the evaluation factorization transports this zero object to the required derived value.

theorem coefficientEvaluationDerivedAbove
    (ordinary : CoefficientOrdinaryEvaluationData (J := J) (O := O) (ell := ell))
    [∀ n, (ordinary.extension n).Additive]
    (core : CoefficientEvaluationDerivedCoreData ordinary)
    (n q : ℕ) (hq : n < q) (N : DerivedCategory (coefficientLevelModules (J := J) O ell n)) :
    IsZero ((core.evaluation q).obj ((core.derivedExtension n).obj N))
